errors.email.address: Enter the mailbox address you want to connect.
errors.email.no_bundled_client: This build ships no bundled Microsoft client. Add your own client ID under “Advanced”.
errors.email.browser: Boba could not open your browser. Open it yourself and try again.
errors.email.timeout: The sign-in was not finished in time. Start again when you are ready.
errors.email.listen: Boba could not open its local sign-in listener. Check that no other app is blocking it, then try again.
errors.email.refused: Microsoft refused the request. Start again; if it repeats, use your own client ID or IMAP.
errors.email.state: That sign-in response did not belong to this attempt. Start again.
errors.email.no_code: Microsoft returned no authorisation code. Start again.
errors.email.offline: Microsoft could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.email.rejected: Microsoft rejected the sign-in. Check your client ID and try again.
errors.email.tokens: The sign-in reply could not be read. Start again.
errors.email.keychain: Boba could not reach your keychain, so nothing was changed.
errors.email.store: Your connections could not be read or saved.
errors.email.needs_reconsent: Reading needs a wider permission than this connection has. Connect again and choose “Read and send”.
errors.email.client_secret: Your own client ID needs its client secret too. Google asks for it when Boba renews access.
errors.email.gmail_read_needs_byo: Reading Gmail needs your own Google client ID. Add one under “Advanced”, or connect send-only.
errors.email.probe_credentials: The mail server did not accept that password or token.
errors.email.probe_unreachable: Boba could not reach that mail server. Check the host and port.
errors.email.probe_refused: That mail server refused the connection test. Check the encryption setting and the port.
